source_title: Save $310 Off the Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2 Tablet, a Cost Effective Android Alternative to the iPad Pro
source_excerpt:
Extra productivity points for already including a clamshell keyboard and digital stylus.
The Apple iPad Pro isn't the only powerful tablet that can double up as an ultra-portable PC. In fact, if you prefer working in a Google Android environment, there are better options out there like the tablet that's on sale for this weekend only. Ahead of Black Friday, Lenovo is discounting its Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2 tablet with Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Platform for just $683.99 with free shipping when you stack two coupon codes " DEALDAYSLIVE " and " EXTRAFIVE ".
Save $310 Off the Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2 Android Tablet
Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2 Tablet With Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Platform
The Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2 is a well-equipped tablet featuring a razor sharp 13" 3.8K (3840x2560) touchscreen display with 1,100 nits of peak brightness, Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Platform CPU, 12GB of LPDDR5X RAM, and 256GB of built-in storage. It ships with Android 17 installed. The Snapdragon 8 Elite Mobile Platform was Qualcomm's flagship mobile processor when it was released at in October of 2024. This is a 3nm chip with 8 total cores and a clock speed of up to 4.3GHz. It has since been succeeded by more powerful options, but this is still a very capable chip that was seen as a significant performance upgrade over its predecessors. It will perform multi-tasking duties and Android gaming superbly.
The tablet also comes with a clamshell keyboard which effectively turns it into a convertible laptop and a Lenovo Tab Pen Pro 2 digital stylus for better touchscreen control than just your fingertips. The iPad requires to buy those separately.
